strongest_angle: Analyzing the 31-page amicus brief filed by Cate Blanchett's Human Consent Foundation and Hollywood coalition in the Southern District of New York against OpenAI and Microsoft.

key_facts.fact: The Human Consent Foundation backed by Cate Blanchett filed a 31-page amicus brief in the Southern District of New York supporting The New York Times against OpenAI and Microsoft.
The amicus brief was filed on Friday in the New York Times lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft by a coalition including the Human Consent Foundation.

Organizations joining the brief alongside Cate Blanchett's foundation include CAA, the Music Artists Coalition, the National Association of Voice Actors, Writer, Inc., and the Creative Coalition on AI.
The Human Consent Foundation filed the brief in the Southern District of New York to challenge OpenAI's core argument that licensing copyrighted work at scale is impossible.
